race.description: Save The Date Warwick Cup Sat 10 Oct - Tickets On Sale Now Mdn Plate
race.comment: CAUTIONARY TAIL (1) showed good early dash and raced on the speed last start before fading to finish 3.5 lengths back in fourth over 1400m at Gold Coast. Will be handy in the run and should prove hard to toss with the 2kg claim from the low draw. HEAVENLY ARTIST (11) raced handy on debut last start and gave a good sight, holding on for second and beaten 2.5 lengths over 1200m at Toowoomba. Can open the winning account this time. POISED TYCOON (5) finished 2.5 lengths away in sixth at his last appearance over 1000m at Gold Coast on September 12. Expected to feature in the finish this time. DIVINELLE (8) has finished runner-up at the past couple and is knocking on the door of a maiden victory. Include from the inside marble.
